_meta.source: ADU Universal Checklist — Planning, Building and Code Enforcement

table_20_60._note: Minimum front setbacks by residential zoning district (feet). Source: Table 20-60 Residential Zoning Districts Development Standards.

property_qualification._note: All three must be true before any ADU is permissible.

property_designations._note: Check each. A 'yes' triggers additional requirements — does not automatically block the ADU.

flood_zones.requirement_if_triggered: Plans must comply with Bulletin #211 flood zone design requirements

historic_property.city_standards_requirement: Apply simplified design standards per Municipal Code Section 20.80.175(E)

wildland_urban_interface.requirement_if_in_wui_zone: Construction must comply with all WUI Fire Conformance Policy requirements

easements.requirement: No construction allowed within the easement area

nonbuildable_area.requirement: Submittal must include pool demolition documents or a geotechnical report and foundation design

standards_note: City and State standards cannot be mixed. Choose one full set.

city._note: Municipal Code 20.80.175. All three ADU types (detached, attached, jadu) can coexist but only 1 ADU total (detached or attached) is allowed alongside a JADU.

detached.allowed_count_note: 1 total between detached and attached — cannot have both

siting.rule: Behind main home OR at least 45 ft from front property line

attached.allowed_count_note: 1 total between detached and attached — cannot have both
attached.prohibition: Prohibited if an existing or proposed conversion ADU is present

max_size_sf.fifty_pct_cap_note: May not exceed 50% of existing primary dwelling livable area

attached.setback_null_note: No numeric setback; must meet minimum Building and Fire codes
attached.front_door_constraint: Must be on a different facade than the main home's front door

jadu.setback_null_note: No numeric setback; must meet minimum Building and Fire codes
jadu.deed_restriction_required: Form 313 JADU Deed Restriction to Planning

state._note: Municipal Code 20.80.176. No historic property requirements. No siting restrictions (front setback may be encroached when necessary).

new_adu.front_setback_encroachment_condition: Only if no other siting allows a minimum 800 sf ADU on the site
new_adu.siting_note: No restriction; front setback may be encroached if needed to fit a minimum 800 sf ADU

conversion.note: Conversion of existing structure or space. Cannot add new floor area except for ingress/egress.
conversion.front_setback_null_note: No setback; up to 150 sf for ingress/egress may be added
conversion.siting_note: No restriction; front setback may be encroached if needed to fit a minimum 800 sf ADU

jadu.front_setback_null_note: No setback; up to 150 sf for ingress/egress may be added
jadu.siting_note: No restriction; front setback may be encroached if needed to fit a minimum 800 sf ADU

city._note: Municipal Code 20.80.175. Applies to duplex and multifamily properties.

detached.allowed_count_note: 1 total between detached and attached — cannot have both

lot_lte_9000_sf.fifty_pct_cap_note: May not exceed 50% of existing primary dwelling livable area

min_side_setback_ft.note: Must meet minimum Building and Fire codes

min_rear_setback_ft.note: Must meet minimum Building and Fire codes

siting.rule: Behind existing building OR at least 45 ft from front property line

attached.allowed_count_note: 1 total between detached and attached — cannot have both

lot_lte_9000_sf.fifty_pct_cap_note: May not exceed 50% of existing primary dwelling livable area

lot_gt_9000_sf.fifty_pct_cap_note: May not exceed 50% of existing primary dwelling livable area

min_side_setback_ft.note: Must meet minimum Building and Fire codes

min_rear_setback_ft.note: Must meet minimum Building and Fire codes

attached.siting_null_note: Must meet minimum Building and Fire codes
attached.front_door_constraint: Must be on a different facade than the main home's front door

state._note: Municipal Code 20.80.176. No historic property requirements.

existing_dwelling.constraint: No more than the number of existing primary units on the property

detached.front_setback_encroachment_condition: Only if no other siting allows a minimum 800 sf ADU on the site
detached.siting_note: No restriction; front setback may be encroached if needed

allowed_count.note: At least 1 always allowed; up to 25% of existing units (e.g. 20-unit building → up to 4 ADUs)

conversion.setback_null_note: No setback requirement; must meet Building and Fire codes
conversion.siting_note: No restriction; front setback may be encroached if needed

fire_safety.access_measured_to: Farthest side of ADU including eaves
fire_safety.water_flow_letter_note: Submit water company letter with permit application. Do not wait — missing this is a leading cause of permit delays.

attached_adu_whole_structure_trigger.result: Entire structure (house + ADU) must be fire-sprinklered

square_footage_measurement.basis: Livable floor space measured to the exterior finish

computed_helpers._note: Helper logic for a modeler — derive these values programmatically.

get_max_adu_size_sf.description: Returns the maximum allowable ADU size in sf given inputs
logic: If fifty_pct_of_main_home_cap is true, also compute 0.5 * main_home_livable_sf
Return the lesser of the two values (or the absolute cap if no 50% cap applies)

get_front_setback_ft.description: Returns minimum front setback in feet for a given zone

get_allowed_adu_count.description: Returns max number of ADUs allowed
logic: For MF State detached: min(8, existing_unit_count) for existing dwelling; 2 for new dwelling
For MF State conversion: max(1, floor(existing_unit_count * 0.25))

check_whole_structure_sprinklers.description: Returns whether entire structure must be sprinklered
